name: braces
description: Vendored copy of braces@3.0.3 patched to fix CVE-2026-93687 / GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm (stack-exhaustion DoS via deeply nested patterns). Depth guards were added to the recursive AST walkers in lib/parse.js, lib/compile.js, lib/expand.js and lib/stringify.js. No upstream release exists, so this copy is pinned via "overrides" in the root package.json. Remove once micromatch/braces publishes a fixed version.
author: Jon Schlinkert (https://github.com/jonschlinkert)
